sentences.text:
13.05.2024 Heard Mr. A. Roshid, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. P.R. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department for the respondent no. 1; Mr. N.
Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 2, 3 & 4; and Ms. R.
Bora, learned counsel for the respondent no. 5.
2. The petitioner no. 1 is the wife of one Late Diputi Mohan Ray whereas the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 are sons of Late Diputi Mohan Ray.

3. It is the case of the petitioners that as per the Records of Right, the shares of Late Diputi Mohan Ray from a plot of land, covered by Dag no. 716 & Patta no. 105, situate at Village - Tukura Part-III,
Matia Revenue Circle, District - Goalpara ['the subject-plot', for short], have devolved upon the three petitioners as co-pattadars after the demise of Late Diputi Mohan Ray.

It is the case of the petitioners that a part of the subject-plot has been acquired for the purpose of 4-laning of National Highway no. 17 under the provisions of the Page No.# 3/3 National Highways Act, 1956.

By three notices, dated 12.01.2023, dated 15.03.2023 & dated 15.03.2023, issued in the name of Late Diputi Mohan Ray, the Competent Authority Land Acquisition [CALA], that is, the respondent no. 3 had informed that compensation amounts of Rs. 3,15,822/-, Rs. 13,83,186/- and Rs. 21,07,984/- have been determined for disbursement as against land acquisition/zirat of a part of the land, which has been acquired out of the subject-plot.

It is the further case of the petitioners that the petitioners have not yet been disbursed their legitimate shares out of the above compensation amounts,
assessed under Section 3G of the National Highways Act, 1956.

2 4. Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam appearing for the respondent nos. 2,
3 & 4 has submitted that he will obtain instructions as to whether the respondent no. 3 has determined the persons entitled to receive the amounts payable under Section 3H[3] of the National Highways Act, 1956.
He has, thus, sought listing of the case on 22.05.2024 to place such instructions.

5. List the case on 22.05.2024, as sought for by Mr. Goswami.
6.
Mr. Roshid, learned counsel for the petitioners shall furnish 2 [two] copies of the writ petition along with the annexures to Mr. Goswami for enabling him to obtain the above instructions.
